reason: The README describes a client-side DSH web chat plugin that estimates token usage and DeepSeek API costs before generation, then replaces the estimate with actual usage and billing information afterward.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天中预估回答所需的 token 和 DeepSeek API 费用，并在回答完成后显示实际用量与费用。
summaries.en: Estimates token usage and DeepSeek API costs in DSH Web Chat before generation, then displays the actual usage and cost after the response completes.

capabilities: estimates token consumption and API cost
renders inline cost notifications in the web chat interface
